limitations: Component arithmetic/projection approval only; no numeric audit runner, observation iterator, prereg/source protocol, actual resource or execution approval.

Scalar/array agreements and near-tie classification are separate checks. Future controller must validate exact metadata/schema/order and scalar metric consistency, retain ambiguity as uncertified, and never choose a new model.

Projection validates all nine headers/payload boundaries/CRC but constructs only three finite immutable G/U/D views. Unused moment values, including NaN, deliberately remain outside audit and are not optimizer-state validation.
